content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00178 The Rte_NvMNotifyInitBlock API shall be executed in the EcucPartition ref- erenced by NvMBlockDescriptor . NvMBlockEcucPartitionRef .

The Rte_NvMNotifyInitBlock API shall be executed in the EcucPartition referenced by the associated NvBlockDescriptor 's NvMBlock- EcucPartitionRef parameter. If this parameter does not exist, the Rte_NvMNoti- fyInitBlock API shall be executed in the EcucPartition referenced by the ECUC parameter EcucDefaultBswPartition .
